## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] No new dependencies (this project is standard-library only)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] If a script now reads files, runs commands, or writes archives: I considered symlinks, paths outside the project, and untrusted input
